note: Simulated domain vocabulary. These are the logical checkpoints used by this academic simulation, simplified from real baggage scan points.

checkpoints.label: Check-In
checkpoints.description: Bag is accepted at the check-in counter and a bag tag is attached. Entry point of the journey.

checkpoints.label: Security
checkpoints.description: Bag passes through the security screening checkpoint.

checkpoints.label: Loading
checkpoints.description: Bag is loaded into the aircraft hold / container.

checkpoints.label: Transfer
checkpoints.description: Bag is moved between aircraft or flights at a transfer hub.

checkpoints.label: Arrival
checkpoints.description: Bag is delivered to the arrivals / reclaim area. Terminal state of the journey.

checkpoints.label: Quarantine Hold
checkpoints.description: Dead-end holding area used only by the alternate demo process configuration. A bag sent here can no longer reach ARRIVAL.
